# Greg's Bail Bonds of Philly
> 24/7 bail bond services across Pennsylvania and West Virginia

Greg's Bail Bonds of Philly provides fast, reliable bail bond services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Licensed PA bail bondsman with over 13 years of experience. Greg answers his own phone — no call centers, no voicemail trees.

- DUI Bail Bonds
- Drug Charges Bail Bonds
- Felony Bail Bonds
- Theft Charges Bail Bonds
- Domestic Violence Bail Bonds
- Probation Violation Bail Bonds
- Sex Crime Bail Bonds
- Violent Crime Bail Bonds
- White Collar Crime Bail Bonds

## Service Area
Philadelphia, Chambersburg, Harrisburg, and East Stroudsburg (The Poconos), PA. Also serving West Virginia (Berkeley and Jefferson counties).

PA Counties: Adams, Bedford, Cumberland, Dauphin, Franklin, Lancaster, Lebanon, Mifflin, Perry, York.
WV Counties: Berkeley, Jefferson.

## About
Greg is a licensed Pennsylvania bail bondsman and member of the Expert Bail Network. He operates 4 offices across PA and WV: Philadelphia (Philadelphia County), Chambersburg (Franklin County), Harrisburg (Dauphin County), and The Poconos (Monroe County). Over 13 years of experience handling everything from misdemeanor to felony bonds.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How much does a bail bond cost?
A: Typically 10% of the total bail amount set by the court. Flexible payment plans are available.

Q: How long does the bail process take?
A: Most clients are released within 2 to 4 hours after bond is posted.

Q: What information do I need to post bail?
A: Full name of the person in custody, booking number, charges, and bail amount. Call Greg and he'll verify everything.

Q: Do you offer payment plans?
A: Yes. Greg works with clients to arrange affordable payment options, even for large bond amounts.

Q: Are you available 24/7?
A: Yes. Greg answers his own phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. No call centers.

Q: Can you help with outstanding warrants?
A: Yes. Greg can often arrange a walk-through, allowing the defendant to be processed and released without spending unnecessary time in jail.
